description: This file defines the S3TablesClient class, which serves as a client for interacting with the Amazon S3 Tables service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, retrieving, and updating namespaces, tables, and policies.

classes.name: S3TablesClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon S3 Tables service, extending AwsClient without adding new properties or methods beyond annotations.
